cause_claim: GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader makes previously implicit access explicit, causing bundle-builder to read 180 rows instead of 90, exceeding worker-runtime max_entries=150. The smallest mitigation is to replace GRANT SELECT ON r0.* with column-specific grants GRANT SELECT ON r0.column1, r0.column2, ... TO svc_bundle_reader where only the columns needed by bundle-builder are granted, preventing the row count from doubling from 90 to 180.
